records.title: The 4/δ Bound: Designing Predictable LLM-Verifier Systems for Formal Method Guarantee
records.reason: A convergence theorem gives termination guarantees for multi-stage LLM-verifier formal verification pipelines; the subject is verification workflow reliability, not inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Operating Conversational Large Language Models (LLMs)in the Presenceof Errors
records.reason: Error injection into Mistral-7B measures how hardware faults degrade MMLU accuracy for conversational LLM dependability; relevant to inference reliability under faults, but it is an evaluation study without a mitigation or serving mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Enhanced Transformer Architecture for Natural Language Processing
records.reason: A modified transformer with full layer normalization, weighted residuals and RL-based positional encoding is proposed for general NLP accuracy; an architecture variant without an inference efficiency or serving focus.

records.title: LargePiG: Your Large Language Model is Secretly a Pointer Generator
records.reason: LargePiG separates content from form in LLM-generated search queries to reduce relevance and factuality hallucinations; a query-generation quality method with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: How can representation dimension dominate structurally pruned LLMs?
records.reason: This analysis shows representation dimension dominates the behavior of structurally pruned LLMs through the linear maps in transformer blocks; pruning insight that informs compression, but no deployable inference mechanism is proposed, so borderline.

records.title: ASDFormer: A Transformer with Mixtures of Pooling-Classifier Experts for Robust Autism Diagnosis and Biomarker Discovery
records.reason: ASDFormer mixes pooling-classifier experts over fMRI connectivity to diagnose autism and find biomarkers; a clinical neuroimaging application with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Activity-Based Costing Framework for Total Cost of Ownership Analysis of LLM Services
records.reason: An activity-based costing framework builds a total-cost-of-ownership model for LLM services, separating infrastructure and organizational cost pools; a financial accounting model for services rather than a technical inference system, so borderline.

records.title: Beyond Transformers: Dendritic State-Space Models
records.reason: Dendritic state-space models add nonlinear dendritic computation to linear-time SSM sequence modeling for vision and language; a generic efficient-architecture proposal without LLM inference evaluation or serving content, hence borderline.

records.title: Analysis on the number of layers in the transformer-based model for neural machine translation
records.reason: Layer counts in transformer encoder-decoders are empirically varied for neural machine translation quality; an architecture sizing study for an MT application with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Scaling transformers to high-dimensional sparse data: a Reformer-BERT approach for large-scale classification
records.reason: A Reformer-BERT hybrid is pretrained for automated cell-type classification from high-dimensional single-cell RNA sequencing data; a bioinformatics application with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Chip-Tuning: Classify Before Language Models Say
records.reason: Chip-tuning probes LLM layers with classifiers to identify and prune redundant layers with marginal quality loss, directly reducing LLM inference cost; a concrete layer-pruning contribution for inference.

records.title: KiC: Keyword-inspired Cascade for Cost-Efficient Text Generation with LLMs
records.reason: KiC cascades cheaper and stronger LLMs using keyword-inspired representative selection to cut API inference cost for text generation; a cascade routing method whose reliability heuristic is application-level, so borderline rather than a serving-system accept.

records.title: Play by the Type Rules: Inferring Constraints for LLM Functions in Declarative Programs
records.reason: Type-rule constraint inference makes LLM operators inside declarative query programs produce outputs aligned with type checkers and database contents; a data-systems integration for correctness of LLM calls, adjacent to inference infrastructure but not efficiency or serving, so borderline.

records.title: Invisible Hands: Gray-Box Bit Flip Attack for Steering LLMs Without Knowledge of Gradients, Data, and Weights
records.reason: A gray-box bit flip attack steers LLM behavior by corrupting parameters without gradient, data or weight knowledge; a hardware-fault security attack study, not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations
records.reason: HyperMem organizes conversational agent memory as a hierarchical hypergraph to capture high-order associations that pairwise RAG retrieval misses; agent memory architecture that affects retrieval at inference, but the contribution is memory representation quality, so borderline.

records.title: Mid-Think: Training-Free Intermediate-Budget Reasoning via Token-Level Triggers
records.reason: Mid-Think uses trigger tokens such as a leading 'Okay' to switch hybrid reasoning models into intermediate thinking budgets without training; a prompting-level control of reasoning length with an inference-cost effect, but no decoding or serving mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: Oblivion: Self-Adaptive Agentic Memory Control through Decay-Driven Activation
records.reason: Oblivion applies decay-driven activation to agent memory read and write paths, reducing interference and retrieval latency as histories grow; an agent memory control framework whose systems benefit is secondary to memory behavior, so borderline.

records.title: AtlasVA: Self-Evolving Visual Skill Memory for Teacher-Free VLM Agents
records.reason: AtlasVA stores visual skill memory for teacher-free VLM agents instead of lossy text summaries; a memory representation for spatial agent tasks, with no LLM serving or decoding mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: MINTEval: Evaluating Memory under Multi-Target Interference in Long-Horizon Agent Systems
records.reason: MINTEval benchmarks memory-augmented agents under multi-target interference over long horizons; an evaluation of agent memory behavior with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: A-TMA: Decoupling State-Aware Memory Failures in Long-Term Agent Memory
records.reason: A-TMA decomposes ghost-memory failures across bank maintenance, retrieval and answer-time resolution in long-term agent memory; a memory-system analysis and overlay for correctness of state, not inference efficiency, so borderline.

records.title: CAPS: Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection for Efficient Parallel Reasoning
records.reason: CAPS cascades adaptive pairwise selection to cut the heavy verification cost of parallel reasoning aggregation at test time; it reduces inference-time compute of a reasoning procedure, but as an algorithmic selection scheme rather than a serving system, so borderline.

records.title: Concatenated Matrix SVD: Compression Bounds, Incremental Approximation, and Error-Constrained Clustering
records.reason: Concatenated matrix SVD is analyzed for compression bounds and incremental approximation across matrix collections including neural network compression; generic numerical compression theory with only partial relevance to model inference, hence borderline.

records.title: Offline Exploration-Aware Fine-Tuning for Long-Chain Mathematical Reasoning
records.reason: Exploration-aware supervised fine-tuning shapes the initialization for RL with verifiable rewards on long-chain math reasoning; a training method with no inference mechanism.

records.title: Hawk: Harnessing Hardware-Aware Knowledge for High-Performance NPU Kernel Generation
records.reason: Hawk retrieves hardware-aware knowledge so LLMs can generate high-performance NPU kernels without violating memory hierarchies; the LLM is a code-generation tool and the product is kernel-development automation, adjacent to inference kernels but not an inference system, so borderline.

records.title: Persistent Memory Through Triple-Loop Consolidation in a Non-Gradient Dissipative Cognitive Architecture
records.reason: Triple-loop consolidation maintains persistent memory in a non-gradient dissipative cognitive architecture whose units are stochastically replaced; an alternative cognitive architecture unrelated to LLM inference systems.

records.title: Hierarchical Long-Term Semantic Memory for LinkedIn's Hiring Agent
records.reason: A hierarchical long-term semantic memory system for LinkedIn's hiring agent extracts structured signals and supports low-latency retrieval at industrial scale; a production agent-memory system, but its contribution is memory quality for one application rather than LLM serving, so borderline.

records.title: OS-Pruner: Pruning Chains-of-Thought of Reasoning Models via Optimal Stopping
records.reason: OS-Pruner prunes chains of thought in reasoning models via optimal stopping, avoiding static budgets and retraining while cutting latency and cost of redundant reasoning steps; a concrete inference-time reasoning-length optimization, hence accept.

records.title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing
records.reason: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B is a specialized model trained with attributed RL to execute memory write paths across external-memory frameworks, lowering reliance on general LLM writers; memory-writing specialization with a serving-cost motivation, but the contribution is a trained writer model, so borderline.

records.title: Evolving Attention with Residual Convolutions
records.reason: Evolving attention propagates attention maps across layers through residual convolutions to improve transformer accuracy on NLP and vision; an accuracy-oriented architecture change with no inference efficiency claim.

records.title: Pointer: Constrained Text Generation via Insertion-based Generative Pre-training
records.reason: POINTER generates lexically constrained text by progressive parallel insertion with a pretrained transformer; a constrained generation method from the BERT/GPT-2 era with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Parallel Training of Deep Networks with Local Updates
records.reason: Local-update parallel training removes synchronization across deep network blocks to parallelize training on large datasets; a training parallelization method, explicitly not inference.

records.title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling for Latent Reasoning Models
records.reason: Parallel test-time scaling is extended to latent reasoning models by adding sampling mechanisms in continuous reasoning space; an inference-time algorithmic scaling study without serving, decoding-system or efficiency mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Quantization Robust Federated Learning for Efficient Inference on Heterogeneous Devices
records.reason: Quantization-robust federated learning trains models that can be deployed at varied bit-widths for efficient inference on heterogeneous devices; the core contribution is federated training robustness, with inference efficiency as a deployment property, hence borderline.

records.title: Unextractable Protocol Models: Collaborative Training and Inference without Weight Materialization
records.reason: Unextractable Protocol Models shard a large network across mutually distrusting participants so full weights never materialize during collaborative training and serving; a decentralized trust framework whose inference aspect is inseparable from its training protocol, so borderline.

records.title: Hardware and Software Platform Inference
records.reason: This work shows buyers of hosted LLM inference cannot verify the advertised model or H100-class hardware and studies fingerprinting of the serving platform; measurement of inference services rather than a serving mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: BCEdge: SLO-Aware DNN Inference Services With Adaptive Batch-Concurrent Scheduling on Edge Devices
records.reason: BCEdge schedules multiple DNN inference services on edge devices with adaptive batch-concurrency under SLOs; edge DNN serving scheduling is close to the scope, but the models and evaluation are generic DNNs rather than LLM inference, so borderline.

records.title: Deep Fusion: Efficient Network Training via Pre-trained Initializations
records.reason: Deep Fusion grows networks from pretrained initializations to cut deep network training cost, studying the mechanism of network growing; a training efficiency method with no inference contribution.

records.title: Towards Inference-time Scaling for Continuous Space Reasoning
records.reason: Dropout-based sampling plus reward-model reranking is adapted to COCONUT continuous-space reasoning for inference-time scaling; an algorithmic test-time study without a serving or decoding-system mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: End-to-End Agentic RAG System Training for Traceable Diagnostic Reasoning
records.reason: Deep-DxSearch trains an agentic RAG system end-to-end with RL for traceable clinical diagnostic reasoning; a healthcare application of LLM agents with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: ENGRAM: Effective, Lightweight Memory Orchestration for Conversational Agents
records.reason: ENGRAM is a deliberately lightweight memory orchestration system giving conversational agents long-horizon consistency without knowledge-graph pipelines; agent memory infrastructure that shapes inference-time context, but focused on memory simplicity rather than serving efficiency, so borderline.

records.title: Breaking the bottleneck in AI clusters with parallel photonic integration
records.reason: Parallel photonic integration performs collective matrix operations optically to remove the scaling bottleneck of processor clusters running distributed AI; cluster interconnect hardware for AI workloads generally, not specifically LLM inference, hence borderline.

records.title: Capability-Aware Dynamic Skill Selection for Memory-Augmented Generation
records.reason: Capability-aware dynamic skill selection chooses skills at the read stage of memory-augmented generation for multi-turn dialogue; an agent memory/generation control method without a serving or decoding mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: AuroraMem: Towards Eternal Memory in Conversational AI
records.reason: AuroraMem modularizes extraction, storage and reuse of structured memory for conversational LLM agents; an agent memory framework whose relevance is context management at inference, but with no serving efficiency contribution, hence borderline.

records.title: Episodic Memory Verbalization Using Hierarchical Representations of Life-Long Robot Experience
records.reason: Large pretrained models verbalize life-long robot episodic experience for question answering about a robot's past; a robotics application of LLMs with no inference-system content.

records.title: MAPLE: Modality-Aware Post-training and Learning Ecosystem
records.reason: MAPLE makes RL post-training of multimodal models modality-aware to cut policy-gradient variance and wasted training on irrelevant signals; a training pipeline contribution, not inference.

records.title: SISA: A Scale-In Systolic Array for GEMM Acceleration
records.reason: SISA is a scale-in systolic array redesign that handles the skewed, input-dependent GEMM shapes produced by LLM workloads, raising processing-element utilization over square arrays; a direct accelerator contribution for LLM execution, hence accept.

records.title: Selective Safety Steering via Value-Filtered Decoding
records.reason: Value-filtered decoding steers LLM sampling with a safety score only when generations are actually unsafe, avoiding unnecessary distortion; a decoding-time safety intervention, relevant to decoding but aimed at alignment rather than inference efficiency, so borderline.

records.title: Addressing Variable Heterogeneity in Distributed Multimodal Training with Entrain
records.reason: Entrain balances heterogeneous multimodal sample workloads in distributed MLLM training through static model parallelism choices; a training framework with no inference contribution.

records.title: PraMem: Practice-derived Experiential Memory for Long-horizon Behavior Prediction
records.reason: PraMem builds practice-derived experiential memory to improve LLM-based long-horizon user behavior prediction; an application of agent memory to behavior prediction, not an inference system.

records.title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay
records.reason: Activity Frames compiles passively captured screen activity into agent memory with a deterministic zero-model pipeline, avoiding repeated frontier-model inference to re-derive routines; an agent memory compilation idea with an inference-cost motivation but no serving mechanism, so borderline.
